title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Thursday, 1 October 2026
description: Today's stories: Siri's AI expanding to five more languages and Google's Gemini 4 entering post-training, the launch of Australia's new AusAlert emergency warning system and the Thriving Kids autism support program, nominations opening for Queensland's Bush Bachelor and Bachelorette, and the Gold Coast's BLEACH Festival opening today. 오늘의 브리핑은 영어에 이어 한국어로도 제공됩니다.
